main_sampler.description: DiCo (training-free divide-and-conquer adaptive parallel decoding) on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, non-AR setting: Divide phase selects seed tokens by top-1 calibrated confidence with Gaussian spacing and trajectory guidance (alpha = 0.5, beta = 0.05, tau1 = 0.3, N = 8), Conquer phase commits positions by the adaptive confidence rule of Eq. 10 inside local clusters (tau2 = 0.6, R_gate = 0.8), Finalize phase commits positions with logit margin > tau3 = 3 in parallel else top-1 confidence; tokens are the greedy arg max of Eq. 2

credited_component.text: Motivation: theoretical analysis and empirical results reveal a gap between the theoretical parallelism and practical performance of dLLMs (first bullet of the contribution list)

census.F2_detail: Token rule: greedy arg max, stated in the paper's own formalisation of the generation process (Eq. 2, Sec. 3.1), which DiCo modifies only in the position set S_t (Eq. 3 and Eq. 10); Theorem 4.1 is stated 'under greedy decoding' and the Finalize fallback is top-1 confidence. Position rule: seed tokens by top-1 calibrated confidence above tau1 = 0.3 with Gaussian spacing and trajectory guidance, cluster commits by the adaptive confidence rule (|S_t|+1)(1-c) < 1 with density threshold tau2 = 0.6, Finalize commits positions with logit margin > tau3 = 3 else top-1 confidence (a C-type position rule, coded A because the token rule is stated). No temperature, truncation, guidance or selection stated. Non-AR setting, generation length 256; semi-AR variant (block size 128) is the other column.
